Capacitor

Lucas Bishop (X-Men 97) is a Mutant who can absorb all forms of energy, store it for later or redirect it back with twice the original force, direct the energy towards augmenting himself & healing himself.

Power/Ability to:

Absorb & store energy for later usage.

The power to absorb and store energy for later use. Sub-power of Energy Absorption, Energy Sourcing, and Energy Containment.

Also Called[]

  • Living Battery/Capacitance
  • Energy Capacitor/Storage

Capabilities[]

The user can absorb energy and store it for later use. This is the most basic method towards absorbing energy, acting as a basis for the power itself. They are able to use the stored energy for any purpose they see fit, channeling it however they please.
